package idp

type IdentityProviderUserInfo struct {
	Identifier  string
	DisplayName string
	Email       string
	AvatarURL   string
}

message.text:
h03.

**Abstraction package:** `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp` (`internal/idp/idp.go`) — defines the provider-agnostic `IdentityProviderUserInfo` type used across implementations.

**Implementation package:** `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/idp/oauth2` (`internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`) — the concrete, and only, protocol implementation, an OAuth2-based `IdentityProvider` (built on `golang.org/x/oauth2`) that ships in the repo.
